fits.instructions: The state gives the session's current title and the latest turns, oldest first, each text cut short; any language may appear. Judge the aim, not the area: does the newest request still serve the goal the title names? Yes when it does that goal, a sub-step of it, work the goal still needs before it can land, or tests, fixes or ships it; a short detour that returns also counts, and a vague title is fine if the aim matches. No when the newest request starts a different goal, especially once the titled goal looks done. Sharing a repo, tools, files or topic is not enough, and the turns that led there do not count; the newest request decides.

criteria.true:
The titled goal still needs this work:
- "Nightly orders ETL into the warehouse" -> adding retries to the load step, then backfilling two missed days
- "修复 iOS 登录页闪退" -> writing a regression test for the crash and opening a pull request with the fix
- "Move user events to Kafka" -> raising disk quota on the broker hosts so the new topic can hold a week of events
- "Staging cluster on Terraform" -> a quick aside about a git command, then back to sizing the node pool
criteria.false:
A new goal, even in the same area:
- "给报表页加 CSV 导出" -> export shipped; now adding two-factor login to the same app
- "Translate onboarding docs to Japanese" -> translation published; now using the same docs toolchain to add site search
- "Benchmark three embedding models" -> benchmarks exposed a slow tokenizer; latest turns rewrite the shared tokenizer service for speed
